scope: Actual installed method bodies with synthetic fixtures; no instantiated host or live services. Private selection-method stubs exist only inside this research probe, not a product API dependency.

results.name: registered-is-not-admitted
results.observation: An inspected definition can exist while excluded from the current step.

results.name: conditional-unavailable-outside-step
results.observation: No admission token means conditional registrations cannot be called.

results.name: resolved-set-is-agent-specific
results.observation: Another Agent identity sees no tools in this admission set.

results.name: unloaded-tool-does-not-return
results.observation: Removal after capture invalidates the admitted tool.

results.name: replacement-invalidates-old-admission
results.observation: Same name with a different registration cannot reuse old admission.

results.name: disposed-set-is-empty
results.observation: Step-owned tool handles cannot be retained as live report data.

results.name: activation-error-is-not-normal-unavailability
results.observation: A failing activation callback rejects resolution instead of returning an absent tool.

results.name: cancelled-resolution-publishes-no-result
results.observation: Cancellation remains cancellation, not a negative capability verdict.

results.name: schema-projection-excludes-executor
results.observation: Public schema projection excludes executable callbacks and detaches parameter data.

results.name: search-ready-can-be-true-on-selection-failure
results.observation: True must never be presented as successful provider selection or network connectivity.

results.name: search-ready-false-is-a-specific-preflight-result
results.observation: False records the selected provider refusing readiness for the named chat route.

results.name: provider-without-readiness-is-not-tested
results.observation: Omitted readiness check defaults true but supplies no successful-test evidence.

results.name: fetch-non-success-status-is-a-normal-result
results.observation: A resolved Promise alone does not prove a usable retrieved page.

results.name: office-skill-activation-needs-next-step
results.observation: Successful skill load admits three Office tools only in a newly resolved step; a failed load admits none.

results.name: office-activation-does-not-leak-to-other-agent
results.observation: The successful activation of one synthetic Agent does not activate another.

results.name: office-admission-does-not-prove-engine-ready
results.observation: An admitted Office conversion still fails when the engine service is absent; no source file is read.
